purpose: Allow Billy Walters-derived intelligence to be disabled, used as advisory context, or given authority to originate Betting Edge BET recommendations without rebuilding or re-versioning Core 1.4.
operationalRule: Changing only mode is intended to take effect for the next eligible Core 1.4 handicap/report run. Historical issued reports remain immutable and retain the Walters mode active when issued.

OFF.description: Walters intelligence is disabled for current handicapping.

ADVISORY.description: Walters intelligence is visible and auditable and may trigger explicit re-review, but it cannot directly create a recommendation.

BET_AUTHORITY.description: A complete, current, arithmetic-verified Walters handicap may originate a Betting Edge BET recommendation and may contribute to Core 1.4 fair value as one independent handicap input. The resulting BET must still pass all normal hard execution, uncertainty, price and exposure gates.

requiredWhenModeIsBET_AUTHORITY: sourceAsOf and generatedAt are valid/current for the event context
power, personnel and game-factor sourceRefs are sufficient to audit the fair build
material unresolved personnel uncertainty is passed through Core personnel/model-error handling
the recommended market/selection has exact Betting Edge identity
the executable Bet365/DraftKings quote is within the normal freshness limit
the Walters edge clears the applicable Core 1.4 conservative uncertainty/model-error boundary
spread-vs-moneyline logic fails closed when corrected Page 270 logic is unavailable
the Walters handicap is not merely the Bet365/DraftKings quote pair, no-vig residual, market consensus or price movement restated as a model
betAuthorityEligibility.originationRule: BET_AUTHORITY may originate a BET even if the ordinary Core handicap did not first nominate the wager. The Walters record must identify the exact market, side, fair, uncertainty and rationale; normal Betting Edge publication/execution gates then determine whether the originated recommendation can be issued.
betAuthorityEligibility.independentSupportRule: Walters counts as at most one independent current handicap input. Its component factors or chapters cannot be decomposed into multiple votes.
betAuthorityEligibility.fairValueRule: Walters fair value may explicitly contribute to the Core 1.4 point estimate or stand as the originating independent fair for a Walters-created candidate. The contribution and resulting fair must be recorded; it may not silently overwrite another Core model.
betAuthorityEligibility.modelErrorRule: Walters uncertainty may raise the Core model-error floor. BET_AUTHORITY does not erase calibration, liquidity, personnel or price-quality uncertainty.
betAuthorityEligibility.playToRule: Walters may propose the economic boundary used to construct a candidate, but final issued playTo must still be produced/validated under Core 1.4 conservative execution rules.
betAuthorityEligibility.stakeRule: Walters may originate BET status but does not directly set risk. Existing Betting Edge staking/exposure policy sizes any issued BET.

provenanceRequired.waltersReviewImpact: concise explanation or NO MATERIAL CHANGE
provenanceRequired.waltersBetRationale: required when Walters originated the BET; otherwise null
